text:
maya: FYI post-deploy quick-synth for /prefill-cold hitting elevated 504s on canary (5%). p95 up ~2x. holding ramp.

deploy-bot: deploy bot: rolling v6.0.1 -> v6.0.2 at 1788888800, canary 5%. smoke probes started 1788888840. failing probes: 22/180 in last 6m.

ben: we shipped a cold-start worker change (lazy_shards=true) to reduce memory, could be increasing latency for cold keys. no model or kernel changes.

chris: can we apply a canary-only override to revert lazy_shards to false and add a short backoff on fetch retries? reduces blast radius vs rollback.

sre-oncall: recommend hold. Plan A: override lazy_shards=false + enable fetch_retry_jitter for canary and re-run focused prefill synth for 8m. Plan B: if failures remain >1% after window, pin canary to v6.0.1 and open rollback.

config-bot: applying config override (canary scope) now: POST /internal/configs/overrides {"scope":"canary","lazy_shards":false,"fetch_retry_jitter":true} 788889012 tx. propagation ~30s.

deploy-bot: synth runners restarting 1788888925 -> collecting targeted prefill samples 40/min.

ben: uploading sample traces to /var/releases/1788888888/traces for triage. highlights show backend fetch latency spikes coincident with cold lookups.

chris: good. if override stabilizes, we'll schedule a revert of lazy_shards in next minor and add a canary gating test for cold-start latency.

sre-oncall: monitoring p95/p99 and 5xx rate. resume criteria: failures <0.8% and p95 within 1.3x baseline sustained for 8m.

maya: 5m mark: failures down to 0.5% (3/600), p95 trending toward baseline.

ben: traces show fetch retry storms suppressed by jitter. looks like the config change fixed the immediate issue.

maya: ok leaving hold until 10m. if stable, resume ramp to 25% and note in release notes: "temporary canary config override for cold-start prefill; follow-up fix planned."

config-bot: 10m mark metrics stable. override remains in place pending follow-up patch. hold released at 1788889548.

sre-oncall: created follow-up ticket ENG-RELEASE-7682 for lazy_shards revert and cold-start synth addition.

maya: closing this ops thread. saved logs and traces to release artifact.
